classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A Blazor authentication state provider that manages user authentication state by fetching user info from an API endpoint, caching it, and creating ClaimsPrincipal objects with relevant claims for the user.

methods.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with HttpClient and Logger, setting up dependencies.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to return the current authentication state, fetching user info if cache is stale or absent.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user ClaimsPrincipal, using cache if valid or fetching fresh data from API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user information from the web API and constructs a ClaimsPrincipal with user claims.
